notes.title: Unlucky Sniper 0.6.3
notes.content:
Changed:

 The pause interface.
 Hitboxes.

Fixed:

 Bug ,when in the "Reverse" mode the sound of detection, regardless of detection.
 Bug, when the game crashed while changing the skin.

Changed:

 Three-second after pause timer.

notes.title: Unlucky Sniper 0.6.1
notes.content:
Fixed:

 Bug, when exiting the menu through a pause, sprites were not recreated after the start of a new game.
 Fixed a bug in the word "Settings" in English localization.
 Aligned buttons and texts in them. (I hope everything is fine now).

Added:

 Screen resolutions. Resolutions 1280x720 and 854x480.
 Fullscreen mode.

notes.title: Unlucky Sniper 0.6
notes.content:
Fixed:

 Bug, when the targets stuck together
 Bug, when sprites respawns in a random place on the screen, sometimes it's respawns right in front of the player.

Added:

 Report card
 Shop
 4 skins
 Boosts: slow down and diamond bullet
 Gold Bullets. game currency for which you can buy in the store

Changed:

 Continue panel
 Bullets were renamed "diamond bullets"
 Texture of counting panel
 Method for obtaining diamond bullets. They can be obtained for 1000 gold bullets.

notes.title: Unlucky Sniper 0.5.3
notes.content:
Fixed:

A bug in which the score in the game was recorded even when it did not exceed the best score.
Bug, when in localized text in Russian was a crooked position.
Bug, when sprites ran into text.

I guess you didn't notice this (except first bug).

notes.title: Unlucky Sniper 0.5.2
notes.content:
Fixed Bugs:

 Error, when closing the game
 Fixed background images and animation

Added:

 New textures
 Hourglass, This is the bonus sprite in "Reverse" gamemode. If you hit the hourglass, you will receive bonus points or time.

notes.title: Unlucky Sniper 0.5.1
notes.content:
Fixed:

 Bug when the changes of the "Bullets" variable have not been saved.

That's all I did lol

notes.title: Unlucky Sniper 0.5
notes.content:
Fixed Bugs:

 Fatal error, when silver coin bumped into other coins and tryed to respawn
 Bug when after a pause the game continued in a mode that was not selected (for example: When playing in "classic" mode after a pause, the game continued in the mode "Reverse")
 Bug when disconnecting 'All sound' some sounds were not turned off in the game
 Bug when exiting the game through the pause score not reset
 Background images redrawn

Added

 Buttons in the menu
 Russian Language
 Bullets. Gambling currency you can use to continue if you lose.

notes.title: Unlucky Sniper 0.4
notes.content:
Added

 New bonus targets: bronze, silver coin and diamond. If you hit the bonus target, you will receive bonus points or time in reverse game mode

Changed

Gold coin texture

notes.title: Unlucky Sniper 0.3
notes.content:
Added

New game mode - reverse. In this mode, on the contrary, you need to hit the target.
Coins - Its a bonus target which gives extra points, or time in the reverse game mode
Tutorial

Fixed

Bullet animation

Delete

Tab "Report a Bug"
